structures.label: Biceps brachii
structures.description: Two-headed front arm muscle inserting on the radius.
structures.function: Bends the elbow and is the main muscle turning the palm up.

structures.label: Triceps brachii
structures.description: Three-headed muscle on the back of the arm, inserting on the olecranon.
structures.function: Straightens the elbow; the long head also extends the shoulder.

structures.label: Brachioradialis
structures.description: Forearm muscle from the lower humerus to the wrist end of the radius.
structures.function: Bends the elbow, strongest with the thumb pointing up.

structures.label: Pronator teres
structures.description: Muscle crossing the front of the elbow from the medial epicondyle to the radius.
structures.function: Turns the palm down and helps bend the elbow.

structures.label: Flexor carpi radialis
structures.description: Forearm flexor arising from the medial epicondyle (common flexor origin).
structures.function: Bends the wrist; overuse of this origin causes golfer's elbow.

structures.label: Extensor carpi radialis longus
structures.description: Forearm extensor arising above the lateral epicondyle.
structures.function: Extends the wrist and bends it towards the thumb.

structures.label: Extensor carpi radialis brevis
structures.description: Forearm extensor arising from the lateral epicondyle (common extensor origin).
structures.function: Extends the wrist; its tendon origin is the usual site of tennis elbow.

structures.label: Anconeus
structures.description: Small triangular muscle at the back of the elbow.
structures.function: Assists elbow extension and steadies the joint.

structures.label: Brachialis
structures.description: Muscle under the biceps attaching to the ulna.
structures.function: The main elbow flexor in every forearm position.

structures.label: Supinator
structures.description: Deep muscle wrapping around the upper radius.
structures.function: Turns the palm up, especially with the elbow straight.

structures.label: Ulnar collateral ligament
structures.description: Fan-shaped ligament on the inner side of the elbow.
structures.function: Resists valgus stress; it is the ligament injured in throwers.

structures.label: Radial collateral ligament
structures.description: Ligament on the outer side of the elbow, blending with the annular ligament.
structures.function: Resists varus stress on the elbow.

structures.label: Annular ligament
structures.description: Ring of ligament wrapping the head of the radius.
structures.function: Holds the radial head against the ulna while it spins.

structures.label: Joint capsule
structures.description: Fibrous sleeve enclosing the humerus, ulna and radius at the elbow.
structures.function: Contains the joint fluid and links the three bones.

structures.label: Humerus (distal)
structures.description: Upper arm bone; its lower end forms the trochlea, capitulum and epicondyles.
structures.function: Upper half of the hinge and origin of the forearm muscles.

structures.label: Ulna
structures.description: Inner forearm bone; its olecranon is the point of the elbow.
structures.function: Forms the main hinge with the humerus.

structures.label: Radius
structures.description: Outer forearm bone; its disc-shaped head spins at the elbow.
structures.function: Rotates around the ulna to turn the palm up and down.
